title: Clause Dependency
description: PER CLAUSE schema (received 2026-09-09 with the update-pass work order). Each protocol clause declares what it depends on. MODEL_PROPERTY clauses can go vestigial when the model changes; GUIDELINE_TEXT clauses can go stale when the tracked document moves; PHYSICS clauses have no expiry. A first-pass inventory leaves still_true as 'untested' with a stated test; 'no' requires status VESTIGIAL and a statement of what replaced the failure mode.

text.description: the clause, verbatim or closely abridged

classification_basis.description: why this bucket; lets a reader reclassify

property_id.description: MODEL_PROPERTY only: shared id when several clauses assume the same property

property.description: MODEL_PROPERTY only: what about the model this assumes

test.description: MODEL_PROPERTY only: what would show it

replaced_by.description: MODEL_PROPERTY with still_true=no: what replaced the failure mode — the gap the clause no longer covers

tracks.description: GUIDELINE_TEXT only: which document, which version

repair.description: GUIDELINE_TEXT with current=no: was the clause written to BE legible to that posture, or to constrain it

axiom.description: PHYSICS only: which axiom (A1–A7) or law, with source

review.description: PHYSICS only: no expiry, no review needed
